document.name: SignInUp
document.purpose: One screen where a returning customer signs in and a new one signs up, with Google, GitHub or email.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.doc: Which form is showing; the container sets the opening one.

inputs.name: name
inputs.doc: Sign-up name field value.

inputs.name: pending
inputs.doc: A submission is in flight. Disables the fields and providers and puts the submit Button in its loading state, which ignores presses.

inputs.name: error
inputs.doc: Message for a rejected sign-in; deliberately does not say whether email or password was wrong.

inputs.name: resetHref
inputs.doc: Where the forgotten-password flow lives.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.type: { title: string; description: string; signInTab: string; signUpTab: string; google: string; github: string; name: string; email: string; password: string; showPassword: string; passwordRule: string; forgot: string; signInSubmit: string; signUpSubmit: string }
inputs.doc: All user-facing text, in the app's language.

document.name: DeploymentAssistant
document.purpose: A conversation with a deployment assistant that can read logs and restart a service, with in-thread approval and a composer.

inputs.name: turns
inputs.doc: The conversation's turns, oldest first. The container renders each as a ChatMessage (role and author set) whose children hold its content, including a ToolCall per tool call and an ApprovalCard before any restart. Empty when there are none.

inputs.name: streaming
inputs.doc: A reply is still arriving.

inputs.name: draft
inputs.doc: The message being written.

inputs.name: onStop
inputs.doc: Stops the reply that is arriving.

inputs.name: attachments
inputs.doc: Files attached to the draft.

props.title: Deployment assistant
props.description: Ask about your deployment. The assistant can read logs and restart a service, and asks before it restarts anything.

props.title: Ask about your deployment
props.description: I can read your service logs to find out what went wrong, and restart a service once you allow it.

document.name: UsageOverview
document.purpose: Shows a team lead how much of their plan the team has used in a chosen period, with four headline numbers and requests per day.

inputs.name: stats
inputs.doc: The four headline stats (requests, error rate, median latency, seats used of bought), already formatted, each with a delta whose direction and positive flag say which way it moved and whether that is good. While loading, the container supplies placeholder stats of the same count so the layout holds.

inputs.name: daily
inputs.doc: Requests per day across the period, one row per day: { date: ISO date, requests: number }.

inputs.name: period
inputs.doc: The selected period: 'this-month' or 'last-month'.

inputs.name: onPeriodChange
inputs.doc: Called when the reader picks the other period.

inputs.name: loading
inputs.doc: True while the numbers load.

inputs.name: onDownload
inputs.doc: Downloads the period's usage as a file.

props.title: Usage overview
props.description: How much of your plan the team has used.

document.name: OrderDetail
document.purpose: One customer's order in full: its status and facts, its history, the support team's comments and a guarded refund.

inputs.name: order
inputs.doc: The order. Display strings (placedAt, total, paymentMethod, shippingAddress, statusLabel) arrive already formatted.

inputs.name: events
inputs.doc: Order events, newest first. Each title says what happened; detail says who did it. Time is pre-formatted.

inputs.name: comments
inputs.doc: Support comments, newest first, mapped by the container: title is the author, time is how long ago, detail is the comment body.

inputs.name: draft
inputs.doc: The comment being written.

inputs.name: onBack
inputs.doc: Returns to the list of orders.

inputs.name: refundDescription
inputs.doc: States the amount being refunded and where it goes.

inputs.name: refundConfirmLabel
inputs.doc: The confirm verb including the amount.

props.placeholder: Write a comment for the support team

document.name: BookRoomScreen
document.purpose: Lets an employee book a meeting room by choosing room, date, start time, length, invitees and an optional note, with validation on submit.

inputs.name: rooms
inputs.doc: The known list of bookable rooms.

inputs.name: durations
inputs.doc: The lengths on offer: 30, 60 and 90 minutes.

inputs.name: room
inputs.doc: Selected room value.

inputs.name: date
inputs.doc: Selected date.

inputs.name: today
inputs.doc: Today's date; the earliest selectable date.

inputs.name: startTime
inputs.doc: Selected start time, as TimeInput value.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.doc: Selected length value.

inputs.name: invitees
inputs.doc: Email addresses invited.

inputs.name: note
inputs.doc: Optional note for the invitation.

inputs.name: validateEmail
inputs.doc: Normalises an email or returns null to reject it.

inputs.name: errors
inputs.type: { room?: string; date?: string; startTime?: string; duration?: string; invitees?: string; note?: string }
inputs.doc: Per-field error messages from the last submit.

inputs.name: summaryErrors
inputs.doc: Every error in form order, each with the field id it names; empty when there are none.

inputs.name: summaryTitle
inputs.doc: Title of the error summary.

inputs.name: submitting
inputs.doc: True while the booking is being made.

inputs.name: onSubmit
inputs.doc: Validates and books the room.

inputs.name: onCancel
inputs.doc: Leaves the screen without booking.

props.title: Book a room
props.description: Choose a room, a time and who to invite.

props.label: Invitees
props.description: Type an email address and press Enter or comma.

document.name: IncidentsScreen
document.purpose: Lets an on-call engineer triage incidents: search, filter by severity and state, sort by when they opened, and delete one after confirming.

inputs.name: incidents
inputs.doc: The incidents that match the current search and filters, newest first unless the sort says otherwise.

inputs.name: columns
inputs.doc: Title, service, severity, status, opened (sortable), and a delete action that asks the container to start a delete.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.doc: The current sort; the container starts it on the opened column, descending.

inputs.name: hasNoIncidents
inputs.doc: True when there are no incidents at all, before any filter is applied.

inputs.name: search
inputs.doc: The title search text.

inputs.name: severity
inputs.doc: The selected severity, or null for all.

inputs.name: status
inputs.doc: The selected state (open or resolved), or null for all.

inputs.name: isFiltered
inputs.doc: True when a search or any filter is set.

inputs.name: resultCount
inputs.doc: How many incidents match, out of how many there are.

inputs.name: onClearFilters
inputs.doc: Clears the search and every filter at once.

inputs.name: isDeleteOpen
inputs.doc: True while an incident is awaiting delete confirmation.

inputs.name: deleteTitle
inputs.doc: The question, naming the incident, e.g. Delete "Checkout latency spike"?

inputs.name: deleteDescription
inputs.doc: Says the named incident will be permanently deleted and that this cannot be undone.

$object.title: No incidents
$object.description: None of your services has raised an incident.

$object.title: No incidents match these filters
$object.description: Try a different search, or clear the filters to see every incident.

document.name: OnboardingProfileStep
document.purpose: The first of four account-setup steps, collecting the customer's name, role and optional photo.

inputs.name: activeStepIndex
inputs.doc: 0-based index of the current setup step; earlier steps are finished. 0 on this screen.

inputs.name: name
inputs.doc: The customer's name.

inputs.name: role
inputs.doc: The selected role value; empty string when none.

inputs.name: roleOptions
inputs.doc: The short list of roles.

inputs.name: photoFiles
inputs.type: { id: string; name: string; size?: number; status: 'uploading' | 'done' | 'error'; progress?: number; message?: string }[]
inputs.doc: The photo as upload rows; empty when none chosen.

inputs.name: continueDisabled
inputs.doc: True until name and role are both filled in.

inputs.name: onContinue
inputs.doc: Moves to the next step.

inputs.name: onSaveAndExit
inputs.doc: Saves what has been entered and leaves setup to finish later.

props.title: Set up your account
props.description: Tell us a little about you. You can leave at any time and pick up where you stopped.

props.title: Drop a photo or click to browse

document.name: WorkspaceSettings
document.purpose: Lets a workspace owner adjust general, notification and access settings, and transfer or delete the workspace.

inputs.name: workspaceName
inputs.doc: Current workspace name.

inputs.name: digestFrequencyOptions
inputs.doc: Daily and weekly.

inputs.name: memberOptions
inputs.doc: Members other than the owner.

inputs.name: deleteTitle
inputs.doc: Question naming the workspace, e.g. Delete “Acme”?

inputs.name: deleteDescription
inputs.doc: Says it is irreversible and that every project in the named workspace is deleted too.

props.title: Workspace settings
props.description: Changes apply to everyone in the workspace as soon as you make them.

props.label: Workspace name
props.description: Shown to every member and in invitations.

props.label: Time zone
props.description: Sets the time zone in which dates are shown.

props.label: Email digest
props.description: Sends members a summary of activity by email.

props.label: Digest frequency
props.description: Chooses whether the digest goes out daily or weekly.

props.label: Member invitations
props.description: Lets members invite other people to the workspace.

props.label: Transfer ownership
props.description: Hands the workspace to another member, and you stop being its owner.

props.label: Delete workspace
props.description: Permanently deletes the workspace and every project in it.
